home.title: Original paintings
home.intro: Every work here is a one-of-a-kind original. Buy directly on the site, with delivery in Israel and abroad.
home.aboutBody: An Israeli painter working in oil and watercolour. Every work ships with a certificate of authenticity.
home.commissionBody: Looking for a work made for you? Get in touch about the idea, the size and the space.
home.metaDescription: Original paintings by an Israeli artist, sold directly with delivery in Israel and abroad.

credits.title: Credits
credits.intro: This site is currently a demo. The images are public-domain paintings from the collection of the Art Institute of Chicago, used as placeholders until the artist's own works are added.

about.title: About the artist
about.metaDescription: About the artist, the studio and how the work is made.
about.intro: An Israeli painter working in oil and watercolour, mostly landscapes, shorelines and still life.
about.body: Every work on this site is a single original, sent with a certificate of authenticity. Works are packed by hand in the studio and shipped with tracking. Studio pickup is available by appointment.
about.studioBody: The studio is in Israel. Visits and pickups are by appointment only.
about.demoNote: This site is currently a demo: the biography and images are placeholders until the artist adds her own.

contact.title: Contact
contact.metaDescription: Questions about works, commissions, shipping and studio visits.
contact.intro: Write about any work, about delivery or about a commission. Replies usually come within two business days.
contact.generalBody: Questions about a specific work, international delivery or a studio visit.
contact.workQuestion: To ask about a specific work, use “Ask about this work” on its page.
contact.commissionBody: Tell us about the idea, the size and the space where the work will hang. We will reply with a proposal and a timeline.
contact.cancelBody: To cancel a purchase, use the cancellation form, or phone or email us.
